message: The other day, I realized it had been way too long since I checked the batteries in our smoke alarms. So, I made it a little family event—everyone gathered around while I climbed up on the step stool (with a bit of dramatic flair, of course!). We took turns testing the alarms, and then I rewarded everyone with hot cocoa for being my safety squad. ☕️ It turned into a cozy reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to be boring; it can be a fun little ritual that keeps us all safe and snug at home. Do you have any family traditions that help with safety?
